fields.title: Senior Software Engineer - Python
fields.description:
We're looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with strong Python skills to join our growing engineering team. You'll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable web applications using Django and other modern technologies.

As a senior member of the team, you'll mentor junior developers, participate in architectural decisions, and help define coding standards and best practices.

This is a full-time position with competitive compensation and benefits.
fields.requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
- 5+ years of experience with Python
- Strong knowledge of Django framework
- Experience with RESTful APIs
- Familiarity with AWS services
- Experience working in a microservices architecture
- Good understanding of database design and optimization
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
fields.benefits:
- Flexible work hours
- Health insurance with family coverage
- Annual performance bonus
- Professional development budget
- Regular team outings and events
- Modern office space with amenities
fields.skills: Python, Django, REST, AWS, Microservices, SQL

fields.title: Data Scientist
fields.description:
Join our data science team to build machine learning models and analyze large datasets that drive business decisions. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data-driven insights.

You'll be responsible for developing and implementing data models, using machine learning techniques, and translating complex findings into actionable insights for the business.

This role offers the flexibility of remote work with occasional visits to our offices for team meetings.
fields.requirements:
- MS or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, or related field
- 3+ years of experience in data science
- Proficiency in Python and data science libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn)
- Experience with deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
- Strong SQL skills and database knowledge
- Experience with big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark) is a plus
- Excellent communication skills to present findings to non-technical stakeholders
fields.benefits:
- Remote work flexibility
- Health insurance
- Education allowance for courses and conferences
- Stock options
- Quarterly team retreats
- Access to high-performance computing resources
fields.skills: Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, SQL, Data Visualization, Statistics

fields.title: DevOps Engineer
fields.description:
We're seeking a talented DevOps Engineer to help automate our infrastructure and improve our CI/CD pipelines. You'll work closely with developers to deploy and scale applications in cloud environments.

Your responsibilities will include managing container orchestration, implementing infrastructure as code, optimizing system performance, and ensuring high availability of our services.

Join us to build and maintain the backbone of our growing technology platform.
fields.requirements:
- Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)
- Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins or GitLab CI
- Scripting skills in Bash and Python
- Knowledge of monitoring and logging systems (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
- Understanding of security best practices in cloud environments
- Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
fields.benefits:
- Flexible work schedule
- Health and dental insurance
- Annual team retreats
- Learning and development budget
- Internet allowance for home office
- Latest hardware and tools
fields.skills: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD, Linux, Terraform

fields.title: UI/UX Designer
fields.description:
We're looking for a creative UI/UX Designer to craft beautiful and functional user experiences. You'll collaborate with product managers and developers to create wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs.

Your designs will shape how users interact with our products, and you'll be involved in the entire design process from research to implementation.

This is a contract position with the possibility of conversion to full-time.
fields.requirements:
- Portfolio demonstrating UI/UX design skills
- Experience with design tools like Figma and Adobe XD
- Knowledge of user research methodologies
- Understanding of accessibility standards
- Ability to create interactive prototypes
- Experience working with design systems
- Basic understanding of frontend development is a plus
fields.benefits:
- Flexible work arrangements
- Design conference allowance
- Latest design tools and equipment
- Collaborative and creative work environment
- Opportunity to work on diverse projects
fields.skills: Figma, Adobe XD, User Research, Wireframing, Prototyping

fields.title: Frontend Developer Intern
fields.description:
We're offering an exciting internship opportunity for aspiring frontend developers. You'll learn modern web development practices while building real-world projects under the guidance of experienced developers.

This internship will provide hands-on experience with React and other frontend technologies, giving you valuable skills to kickstart your career in web development.

Successful interns may be considered for full-time positions after the internship period.
fields.requirements:
- Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Familiarity with React or willingness to learn
- Understanding of responsive design principles
- Ability to work in a collaborative environment
- Strong desire to learn and grow as a developer
- Some knowledge of Git version control
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science or related field
fields.benefits:
- Mentorship from senior developers
- Certificate upon completion
- Possibility of full-time employment
- Flexible hours
- Exposure to real-world projects and workflows
- Networking opportunities
